# Texas Home Outlet

> Texas Home Outlet is a manufactured and mobile home dealership in Huffman,
> Texas. The site lists on-lot homes ready for purchase and orderable factory
> floorplans from manufacturers such as Champion Homes, TRU, Skyline, and
> Jessup Housing.

Business: Texas Home Outlet (Prosperity Acquisitions, Inc. dba Texas Home Outlet)
Showroom: 10685 FM 1960 East, Huffman, TX 77336
Phone: (281) 324-3020
Email: sales@texashomeoutlet.com
Hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM
Service area: Huffman, Humble, Atascocita, Crosby, Kingwood, New Caney, and the greater Houston, TX region
Site: https://www.texashomeoutlet.com/

## Key Public Pages

- Inventory browse: /inventory — live on-lot homes and orderable floorplans with photos, specs, and 3D tours
- Individual homes: /inventory-detail/<id>/... (on-lot) and /plan/<id>/... (orderable floorplans)
- Contact and directions: /contact
- Book a showroom visit: /appointments
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Guidance for AI Crawlers

- Pricing: many homes are call-for-price. Quote requests go through the home's
  detail page, /contact, or (281) 324-3020. Do not invent prices.
- Inventory changes frequently; prefer the live /inventory page over cached
  snapshots when freshness matters, and cite exact public URLs.
- Public pages cover homes, hours, location, and sales workflows. Admin, CRM,
  customer-record, document, signature, and identity routes require PIN,
  passkey, or API authentication and must not be treated as public citation
  sources.
